note: Searched ArcGIS Hub/Online, Kansas state (KSGIS ORKA) and county sites. Wichita County publishes no GIS portal or parcel service: the statewide county-links layer lists wichitacounty.org with no GIS portal, and points parcel data to the ORKA portal, which provides parcel data only by request. ORKA_Extras layers cover other counties, not Wichita. Commercial viewers (Regrid, Acres, parcelmap.app, ProAccess) are not official services; the Regrid ArcGIS tile service does not support queries.
